overlayRule: Generated clips provide camera, light, material and spatial transition only. Program-rendered true UI covers any generated lettering, icons, labels, lines, numbers or report text before delivery.

v8-demand-to-platform.maskPolicy: First 96 frames: composite exact true brief page over generated page plane. Last 72 frames: dissolve the page mask along the right plane edge into native camera; leave the model and ocean bridge visible.

v8-geometry-to-section.maskPolicy: Composite exact viewer-model over left web viewport during first 72 frames; hide any generated blue linework outside the real viewer crop.

v8-report-to-delivery.maskPolicy: Composite exact checklist-edited/report crop during first 90 frames; no generated paper writing or pass/fail mark survives the web-to-platform transition.
